hotels.title: Relaxed Sunshine Coast Self-Contained Apartment Stay with Lagoon Pool
hotels.description: Gather friends and family and escape to the Sunshine Coast with a relaxing stay just moments from the sands of Bulcock Beach. With all the comforts of home at your cosy apartment and space to cook up a barbecue feast., you're set for fun with the family or a group of friends. Refresh in the lagoon pool, unwind in the spa or get your heart pumping at the fitness centre. Ideally located in the heart of Caloundra, this modern retreat is a stone's throw from the town's vibrant dining and shopping precinct, and only a 30-minute drive from Australia Zoo. Whether your ideal holiday is swimming in the ocean, exploring art galleries or getting some retail therapy in, you'll find it here.

hotels.title: Fun-Filled Sunshine Coast Escape with Waterpark & Mini-Golf Course
hotels.description: The whole family or a group of friends can enjoy an escape brimming with extra-special, fun in the sun moments when staying at Oaks Sunshine Coast Oasis Resort. Incredible facilities include an exciting onsite waterpark, large outdoor swimming pool, mini-golf golf course, sandpit, climbing frame and giant Kangaroo Jumper - there's something for all ages. The Oak & Vine Sunshine Coast restaurant is a popular eatery for Caloundra locals or visitors and is perfect for a tasty meal along the waterfront or a glass of wine on the deck.
